run_f_gold: run f_gold to find two array elements whose sum equals the sum of the rest
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify pair-sum correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that uses a set to find complementary pairs
review_f_gold: review f_gold for the missing return statement on the success path
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the pair instead of printing it to stdout
